blocks.text: Paper chromatography partition chromatography hai: kaghaz ke cellulose reshon mein phansa pani aur kaghaz par se guzarne wala mobile phase na-milne wale hain, mobile phase aam taur par organic liquid hota hai. Yeh teen tarah ki jati hai, ascending, descending aur radial (circular); sirf ascending qism bayan hai, jis mein solvent capillary action se oopar chalta hai (Figures 15.8 aur 15.9).

blocks.alt: Do dhakan wale jar. Baayen: kaghaz ki patti (stationary phase) solvent (mobile phase) mein doobi hai aur solvent ke zara oopar siyahi ka spot. Daayen: solvent, solvent front tak chadh gaya aur spot narangi, neele, sabz aur laal spots mein bat gaya; teer solvent ke behne ka rukh dikhata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 15.8: Paper chromatography (kitab ki Figure 15.8 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Solvent capillary action se kaghaz par oopar chadhta hai aur siyahi ke ajza ko saath le jata hai. Jo juz solvent mein zyada hal hota hai woh zyada oopar jata hai (narangi), jo kaghaz ke pani se zyada chipakta hai woh neeche rehta hai (laal). Kitab ke label mein 'stationery' chhapa hai; sahih 'stationary' (thehra hua) hai, aur caption ka 'chromatagraphy' bhi 'chromatography' hona chahiye.

Namoone ke mutabiq banaya solvent mixture chromatographic tank mein dala jata hai, jise andar ki fiza yaksan karne ke liye dhaka jata hai. Whatman chromatographic paper No. 1 (chune hue cotton cellulose se bana, darmiyani retention aur flow rate, soorakh ka size 11 micrometres) ki taqreeban 20 cm ki patti par ek sire se taqreeban 2.5 cm par pencil ki patli lakeer khinchi jati hai, aur lakeer par namoona mixture solution ka ek spot rakha jata hai; ajza pehchanne mein madad ke liye maloom compounds ke spots saath rakhe ja sakte hain. Spots sookhne par kaghaz clips se latkaya jata hai taake spot wala sira solvent mein 5 se 6 mm doobe, aur tank dhaka jata hai. Jaise solvent front spots se guzarta hai solutes mukhtalif raftaron se oopar chalte hain, jo mixture alag karta hai. Jab solvent front kaghaz ki taqreeban lambai tak charh jaye to patti nikali, front pencil se nishan-zada aur patti sukhai jati hai.

blocks.alt: Do band jar. Ascending tareeqa: kaghaz neeche pani ki pyali mein khara hai, spot pani ke zara oopar. Descending tareeqa: kaghaz oopar pani ki trough se latka hai, spot trough ke zara neeche.
blocks.caption: Figure 15.9: Ascending aur descending paper chromatography (kitab ki Figure 15.9 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Ascending mein solvent neeche se oopar chadhta hai, descending mein oopar ki trough se neeche utarta hai (kashish-e-saql, gravity bhi madad karti hai). Dono mein spot pehle solvent ke qareeb lagaya jata hai magar solvent mein duboya nahi jata. Kitab mein 'spol of indicator' chhapa hai; sahih 'spot of indicator' hai.

blocks.prompt: Paper chromatography mein ajza kis bunyad par alag hote hain, us ke phases kya hain, aur pani aam taur par solvent ke taur par kyun istemal nahi hota (Quick Check 15.4a, b; exercise Q.2f, i, j)?
blocks.explanation: Ajza is liye alag hote hain ke har ek stationary phase, cellulose reshon mein ruka pani, aur mobile phase, kaghaz par oopar chalta organic solvent, ke darmiyan mukhtalif taur par taqseem hota hai; mobile phase ko tarjeeh dene wale door jate hain. Pani mobile phase ke taur par istemal nahi hota kyunke woh stationary phase hai; pani ka mobile phase us se na-milne wala na hota aur sab kuch saath le jata.

items: Paper chromatography (partition): stationary phase = cellulose mein pani, mobile phase = organic solvent; ascending, descending ya radial.
Ascending: dhaka tank, Whatman No. 1 patti, pencil lakeer 2.5 cm, namoone aur maloom compounds ke spots, 5 se 6 mm dubana, ajza mukhtalif raftaron se uthte hain, front nishan-zada, sukhana.
